**Lua errors or diagnostics**
Paste the full Lua error and stack trace, if available. `/ah` opens settings; it does not produce a debug dump.

For performance issues, run `/ah perf on`, reproduce the issue, then run `/ah perf off` and paste `/ah perf report`. Include what you did during the recording.
